title: From 13,390 BTC to 518 BTC: Bhutan Continues Offloading Bitcoin
summary: The Bhutan government’s Bitcoin selling spree is continuing as it transferred 400 BTC ($31.78M) out of its wallets on September 7, 2026.
content: The Bhutan government has continued its Bitcoin selling spree by transferring 400 BTC, valued at approximately $31.78 million, out of its wallets. This latest transaction follows a significant reduction in the nation's digital asset holdings, as its total reserves have dropped from 13,390 BTC down to 518 BTC amid ongoing offloading activity.
